title: RSU vesting conditions
question: Does registration effectiveness alone guarantee immediate full vesting of the disclosed RSU grants?
prepared_advice: Effectiveness satisfies the performance condition, but does not replace the separate service condition; effectiveness alone does not guarantee immediate full vesting of every grant.

evidence.text: The described RSUs have both service-based and performance-based vesting conditions.
evidence.source_locator: Note 17 Subsequent Events, F-65; find: The RSUs are subject to both service-based and performance-based vesting conditions

evidence.text: Registration effectiveness satisfies the performance condition; the service condition generally runs quarterly over four years, with a new-hire cliff and continuous-service requirement.
evidence.source_locator: Note 17 Subsequent Events, F-65; find: The performance-based vesting condition of the RSUs will be satisfied upon the effectiveness

title: Class F voting fallback
question: Under what conditions does the Class F voting fallback apply?
prepared_advice: For an applicable general matter, if a majority of Continuing Founders gives no instruction and the required Class A quorum is present, Class F votes track the Class A votes proportionally; this need not hold for special matters.

evidence.text: For specified general matters, absent a majority Continuing Founder instruction, Class F votes proportionally with Class A votes cast, subject to a quorum of a majority of outstanding Class A shares.

evidence.text: Other matters carry distinct special voting thresholds.
